subproblem.title: The cycle condition tested on φα gives ∫Dφ[v]dν = 0 for a Riesz vector v of α
subproblem.statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P, ζ₀ ∈ Λ_{d+1}(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P (d+1)), α a d-covector, v ∈ ℝ^P and φ : ℝ^P → ℝ a C^∞ function with compact support. Assume (i) ∫ζ₀(dψ(y))dν(y) = 0 for every test d-form ψ ∈ TestFormOn univ d, where dψ := exteriorDerivative ψ, and (ii) ζ₀(γ) = ⟨v, w⟩ whenever w ∈ ℝ^P and γ is a (d+1)-covector with γ(u) = Σ_{i=0}^{d} (−1)^i⟨w, u_i⟩α(Fin.removeNth i u) for all u. Then ∫Dφ(y)[v]dν(y) = 0.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P (d + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) d) (v : Euclid P) (φ : Euclid P → ℝ), (∀ ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, ∫ y, ζ₀ (exteriorDerivative (ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y) ∂ν = 0) → (∀ (w : Euclid P) (γ : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1)), (∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, γ u = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (inner ℝ w (u i) * α (i.removeNth u))) → ζ₀ γ = inner ℝ v w) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y, fderiv ℝ φ y v ∂ν = 0
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 3, 4 and 5(i) of the parent proof (the test form ψα, the identity d(ψα)(y) = (∇ψ(y))^♭∧α, and ∫Dψ(y)[v_α]dν(y) = ∫ζ₀(d(ψα)(y))dν(y) = 0), with the Riesz vector v_α replaced by an arbitrary vector v having its defining property (hypothesis (ii) below). Uses the sibling extderiv_smul (accepted dgcr_bwd_extDeriv_smul_const): for a : ℝ^P → ℝ differentiable at x and a constant m-covector β, exteriorDerivative (y ↦ a(y)•β) x u = Σ_{i=0}^{m} (−1)^i·(Da(x)(u_i)·β(removeNth i u)) for all u.
Notation: ℝ^P = Euclid P with real inner product ⟨·,·⟩; Dφ(y) = fderiv ℝ φ y; C^∞ means ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞); a test d-form ψ ∈ TestFormOn univ d is a d-form ψ : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) d with IsTestForm ψ (IsSmoothForm ψ, i.e. ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ, and HasCompactSupport ψ) and tsupport ψ ⊆ univ (membership in testFormOnSubmodule univ d). Hypotheses: (i) ∫ζ₀(dψ(y))dν(y) = 0 for every test d-form ψ; (ii) ζ₀(γ) = ⟨v, w⟩ whenever w ∈ ℝ^P and γ is a (d+1)-covector with γ(u) = Σ_i (−1)^i·(⟨w, u_i⟩·α(removeNth i u)) for all u : Fin (d+1) → ℝ^P; φ is C^∞ with compact support.
1. (The test form φα.) Let ω(y) := φ(y)•α. It is C^∞ as the product of the C^∞ scalar function φ with the constant covector α (ContDiff.smul with contDiff_const); it has compact support because ω(y) = 0 whenever φ(y) = 0 (HasCompactSupport.smul_right); and tsupport ω ⊆ univ trivially. Hence ω ∈ TestFormOn univ d.
2. (The hypothesis on ω.) By (i) applied to ψ := ω: ∫ζ₀(dω(y))dν(y) = 0.
3. (Pointwise identity ζ₀(dω(y)) = Dφ(y)[v].) Fix y ∈ ℝ^P. Since φ is C^∞ it is differentiable at y. Let g := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ ℝ^P).symm (Dφ(y)) be the gradient of φ at y; by the Riesz representation, ⟨g, h⟩ = Dφ(y)(h) for every h (InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply). By extderiv_smul with m = d, a = φ, β = α, x = y, for every u: dω(y)(u) = Σ_i (−1)^i·(Dφ(y)(u_i)·α(removeNth i u)) = Σ_i (−1)^i·(⟨g, u_i⟩·α(removeNth i u)). So γ := dω(y) satisfies the formula of (ii) with w := g, and (ii) gives ζ₀(dω(y)) = ⟨v, g⟩ = ⟨g, v⟩ (symmetry of the real inner product, real_inner_comm) = Dφ(y)(v).
4. (Conclusion.) By step 3 the functions y ↦ Dφ(y)[v] and y ↦ ζ₀(dω(y)) coincide at every y, so their integrals with respect to ν coincide (integral_congr_ae applied to an everywhere-true equality; no integrability is needed). Therefore ∫Dφ(y)[v]dν(y) = ∫ζ₀(dω(y))dν(y) = 0 by step 2. ∎

theorem Submission.cbr_ci_cp_dir_cycle_fderiv_integral_zero : ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P (d + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) d) (v : Euclid P) (φ : Euclid P → ℝ), (∀ ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, ∫ y, ζ₀ (exteriorDerivative (ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y) ∂ν = 0) → (∀ (w : Euclid P) (γ : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1)), (∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, γ u = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (inner ℝ w (u i) * α (i.removeNth u))) → ζ₀ γ = inner ℝ v w) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y, fderiv ℝ φ y v ∂ν = 0 := by
  intro P d ν ζ₀ α v φ hcyc hv hφ hφc
  have hmem : (fun y => φ y • α : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) ∈
      TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d :=
    ⟨⟨hφ.smul contDiff_const, hφc.smul_right⟩, subset_univ _⟩
  have h := hcyc ⟨_, hmem⟩
  rw [← h]
  refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ y := (hφ.differentiable (by simp)) y
  set g : Euclid P := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (Euclid P)).symm (fderiv ℝ φ y) with hg
  have hγ : ∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, exteriorDerivative (fun y => φ y • α) y u = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (inner ℝ g (u i) * α (i.removeNth u)) := by
    intro u
    rw [Submission.dgcr_bwd_extDeriv_smul_const P d φ α y u hd]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [hg, InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]
  have hz := hv g _ hγ
  show fderiv ℝ φ y v = ζ₀ (exteriorDerivative (fun y => φ y • α) y)
  rw [hz, real_inner_comm, hg, InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]
proof_key_steps: ω := φα is a test d-form (C^∞ by ContDiff.smul with a constant, compact support by HasCompactSupport.smul_right), so hypothesis (i) gives ∫ζ₀(dω(y))dν(y) = 0.
With the gradient g = (toDual ℝ ℝ^P).symm (Dφ(y)), extderiv_smul shows dω(y)(u) = Σ_i (−1)^i⟨g, u_i⟩α(removeNth i u), so (ii) gives ζ₀(dω(y)) = ⟨v, g⟩ = ⟨g, v⟩ = Dφ(y)[v].
